profile.headline: Software Developer | Cybersecurity | React, Python, AWS
profile.summary:
IT graduate with a B.S. in Information Technology from Georgia Gwinnett College. I build secure, cloud-connected applications using Python, React, Next.js, Firebase, and AWS.

https://bradley-portfolio.web.app/

🚀 NASA Artemis Mission – I built a real-time anomaly detection dashboard using Python and Dash, serving as Data Modeler and Testing Lead for the software development team.
🎬 FlickerLog – Co-built a deployed full-stack film discovery app using Next.js, Firebase, ChakraUI, and the TMDB API. Live at flicklog-980df.web.app
🛠 Tech: Python, Java, React, Next.js, Firebase, AWS, Docker, Kali Linux, Wireshark, SQL, CI/CD, Agile, Scrum, JIRA, JUnit, Pytest
📜 Currently completing the Google Cybersecurity Certificate. Also hold certifications from Cisco, Microsoft, and AWS.

Open to junior roles in software development, cybersecurity, or DevSecOps.

positions.title: Picker/Shipper
positions.locationName: Peachtree Corners, Georgia, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Engaged with warehouse staff including sales, management, logistics, and RMA about various orders. Picked & Shipped, and verified orders using a ticket system. 
Assisted in unloading packaged shipments for logistics and RMA
Organized and stacked inventory, consistently helped hit record weekly shipment numbers, enabled learning opportunities with business infrastructure,

positions.title: Picker
positions.description: Picked, shipped, and verified orders using a ticket system; broke all-time weekly shipment highs. Worked with sales, management, logistics, and RMA staff on order issues. Unloaded incoming shipments for logistics and RMA; organized and stacked inventory.

positions.title: PICS Inventory Specialist
positions.description:
IT Gathering info:
 - Collaborate with IT team to address project requirements: 
 - Reporting layouts / Variance reporting live. Record layout for validation file
 - Barcode specifications, Data return preferences, Other specific needs

Wall-To-Wall Inventory:
 - Thoroughly test and validate files, programs, Variance reporting, and process flows.
 - We ensure accuracy and efficiency in ever physical inventory count.

Inventory Day:
 - Conduct a pre-inventory walk-through for first-time inventories or stores with new managers.
 - Ensure smooth flow and comprehensive coverage of all areas and fixtures.
 - Collaborate for a professional inventory experience.

Post-Inventory:
 - Complete electronic report cards to evaluate process adherence and performance.
 - Review feedback and plan future inventories

positions.title: Server, Bartender, Cook
positions.description:
Server: Front theatre customer service, placed orders through mobile application devices, assisted guests to seats and placed food orders
Cook: Station line-cook, prepped food for upcoming shifts, closed-cleaning the kitchen, consistent communication
Service-Bartender: made alcohol beverages for orders rung-in by front of house, delivered alcohol to guests
